label: Real data (ML-NDT)
protocol: Pre-registered threshold false call analysis and trade-off curves.
protocol_note: Scoring protocol: Clean scans are scored with every LOCO fold model. Trade-off curves and false-call counts are computed per fold (each fold evaluates its own clean scores against its own held-out flawed scores). Totals and pooled summaries pool (fold, scan) pairs across all folds at pre-registered operating thresholds.

pooled_summary.description: Pooled across all LOCO folds; pools per-fold operating points.
